title: Bering Land Bridge National Preserve: Broken Windsock at Serpentine Hot Springs
summary: The windsock at the Serpentine Hot Springs airstrip is broken, and the National Park Service is in the process of ordering a replacement. At this time, we do not have an estimated date for when it will be reinstalled. Please use caution when utilizing the airstrip.

title: Bering Land Bridge National Preserve: Phone lines working intermittently
summary: Our phone lines are working intermittently. If you are not able to reach us by phone, please email us at bela_information@nps.gov.

title: Environmental Protection Specialist — National Park Service
summary: This position is located within the Department of the Interior's National Park Service, Alaska Region, and supports Western Artica National Parklands in Kotzebue or Nome, Alaska. $69,789–$109,777 per year

title: Bering Land Bridge National Preserve
summary: Bering Land Bridge National Preserve lies at the continental crossroad that greatly influenced the distribution of life in the Western Hemisphere during the Pleistocene Epoch. It is a vital landscape for Indigenous communities who depend on the land just as their ancestors did for many generations. It is a wild and ecologically healthy landscape unlike any other.
